correctness.rationale: For n>=2 the exact graph is the categorical C5 x Kn, not Cartesian. The n=2 base graph is C10; an independently reconstructed 122-face independence complex admits 48 checked elementary free-face pairs to the octahedral 2-sphere. Signed oriented fixed-face Lefschetz sums yield -1 for color swap, -1 for position reflection and +1 for rotation. The published all-n wedge of (n-1) 2-spheres fixes rank and integral freeness. Each color merge p_j is simplicial and retracts the corresponding two-color cycle, with p_j(z_{in})=delta_{ij} eta, establishing a primitive rank-(n-1) integral basis and the differences z_ab=z_an-z_bn. Hence the S_n augmentation module and D5 reflection sign, with no other reduced homology. Independent checks were bounded and the cited all-n homotopy theorem plus retraction argument, not finite extrapolation, supports universality.
risks: General claim relies on independently read established rank theorem; the local finite tests alone cannot prove all n.
